title: When the registration fee is a problem
bc_short: When the fee is a problem
meta_title: When the registration fee is a problem — Battle for Middle-earth 2026
description: Want to come to Battle for Middle-earth but the registration fee is a barrier? Get in touch. The arrangement may be in the form of help, a discount or support from donors.
subtitle: Get in touch. We’ll try to find a way.
intro_p1: We know that participating in a multi-day event can be financially demanding for some. We don’t want the registration fee to be the only reason someone can’t take part.
intro_p2: If you want to come, but the registration fee is a problem, get in touch. We can’t promise a solution to everyone in every case, but we will try to find an option that makes sense for you and the organisers.
options_intro: The arrangement could look like this, for example:
opt_1_post: — small tasks before the event (logistics, coordination, material prep).
opt_2_post: — on-site registration, weapon checks, infrastructure, children’s game, side programme.
opt_3_post: — Sunday is a workday, every hand counts.
opt_4_strong: Individual reduction of the registration fee
opt_4_post: — depending on the situation and arrangement.
opt_5_mid: — some participants contribute to the participation of others (see
opt_6_post: — if you have an idea or a specific situation, tell us.
alert_individual: This is not an automatic entitlement or "blanket discount for everyone". We handle arrangements individually based on the scope of help, the situation and the event’s capacity.
how_intro: In your message, briefly let us know:
how_l1: that you want to discuss the registration fee,
how_l2: what form of help or arrangement you have in mind,
how_l3: whether you have a specific skill or time flexibility you can offer,
how_l4: whether anything affects your situation that’s good to know in advance (e.g. health, transport, accompanying a child).
alert_privacy: We treat personal information sensitively and confidentially. We don’t publish individual participants’ situations and arrangements are handled individually.
rel_2_post: — if you want to help someone else by contributing.
rel_3_post: — a way to get involved where the reward often covers the registration fee.
rel_4_post: — if you’re not sure how to start.
cta_body: Write us. Better to get in touch early than miss the event because we don’t know about you.
